# refplat-site (agent notes)

The public docs site (refplat.org). See `README.md` for the full picture; the essentials:

- **Single source.** `src/content/docs/`, `src/sidebar.json`, and copied posters in `public/` are
  **generated by `sync.mjs`** and git-ignored — never edit them. Change the canonical file under
  `../docs/learn/` (or `../docs/adrs/`) and re-run `node sync.mjs`.
- **Preview is a static server.** `npm run preview` serves a snapshot of `dist/`; rebuild and restart
  it after changes. Verify diagrams in real Chrome (dark), not rsvg — see the
  `learning-portal-diagrams` skill and `DIAGRAMS.md`.
- **Deploy is automatic** on merge to `main` via `../.github/workflows/deploy-site.yml` → Railway.

## Build / dev

```bash
npm ci
node sync.mjs
npm run build     # -> dist/   (or: npm run dev for http://localhost:4321)
```
